case_number: 2025 INSC 117; SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION(C) NOS.2625-2627 OF 2025
summary: Writ jurisdiction under Article 226 not maintainable against private company; Muthoot Finance Ltd. not 'State' under Article 12; loan transaction private law matter; arbitration clause in agreement; remedy lies in civil suit or arbitration; reliance on LIC v. Escorts Ltd.; public law vs private law distinction affirmed; interim order violation does not confer writ maintainability.
final_judgment: Special leave petition dismissed; High Court's impugned order set aside; writ petitions not maintainable; petitioner to pursue civil or arbitration remedy.
